title: An Art-centric perspective on AI-based content moderation of nudity

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the false positive rates (incorrectly classifying safe art as unsafe/pornographic) of NSFW image classifiers on artworks depicting female bodies versus male bodies.

Analyzing false positive censorship rates across different historical time periods, specific artists, and artistic styles to determine if certain forms of art are disproportionately flagged by NSFW classifiers.
